title: Garlic Shrimp with Chickpea-Spinach Gravy
description: Shrimp poach in a mild garlic broth and are served with spinach and a smooth, spoon-coating chickpea gravy.

ingredients.name: raw large shrimp
ingredients.note: Peeled, deveined, tails removed; thaw and drain.

ingredients.name: cooked chickpeas
ingredients.note: Unsalted and very tender; drain and rinse.

ingredients.name: baby spinach
ingredients.note: Remove stems and chop very finely.

ingredients.name: low-sodium chicken broth
ingredients.note: Choose plain meat-and-bone broth without a vegetable blend.

steps.title: Warm the garlic broth
steps.text: Simmer {garlic}, {paprika}, {beans} and {broth} in the HexClad over medium-low for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Make a smooth base
steps.text: Transfer to the heatproof jug and blend until the chickpeas are completely smooth. Return the puree to the skillet.

steps.title: Wilt the spinach
steps.text: Fold {spinach} into the puree and simmer for 2 minutes until completely tender.

steps.title: Poach the shrimp
steps.text: Nestle {shrimp} into the loose sauce and cover. Simmer gently for 3–6 minutes, turning once, until the largest shrimp are pearly and opaque all the way through. Lift them to a warm covered bowl with a little sauce.

steps.title: Mix the slurry
steps.text: Stir {starch} into {water} in a small cup until smooth.

steps.title: Thicken the sauce
steps.text: Whisk the freshly stirred slurry into the simmering sauce and stir for 1 minute, until it coats the back of a spoon.

steps.title: Finish with lemon
steps.text: Stir {lemon} into the gravy off heat. Fold the shrimp back in and divide the extra gravy between the bowls.

notes: Make ahead: Puree the chickpeas and broth up to a day ahead. Keep the raw shrimp refrigerated separately until cooking. Option A uses lemon and a little smoked paprika. For gentler Option B, omit the lemon and use sweet unsmoked paprika. Refrigerate promptly in shallow portions and use within 3 days. Freezer-Friendly Verdict: No. Reheated shrimp can toughen after freezing. Freeze the gravy alone for up to 2 months and poach fresh shrimp for serving. Fridge reheat: Warm a single portion with its sauce in a covered HexClad skillet over medium-low, adding a splash of water if thick. Stir or turn gently and begin checking after 5 minutes. Heat the shrimp to 165°F throughout. Freezer reheat: If already frozen, thaw overnight in the refrigerator and follow the fridge reheating directions.
